title: Why the Same Advice Keeps Finding You (It's Not Willpower)
description:
You've heard it before. Wake up with intention. Build habits. Protect your energy. You nodded. Nothing changed. This video is about why — and it's not what the self-improvement industry wants to say.

The reason advice doesn't stick isn't willpower or discipline. It's timing. Advice requires lived context to absorb, and no amount of reading manufactures readiness before you've experienced what the advice is pointing at. In this video I break down the four reasons we stay stuck in the advice loop — including how consumption becomes a substitute for discomfort, what actually makes things land, and why you cannot shortcut the sequence of growth no matter how much you read.

This comes from my own experience as a data scientist who understands information theory and still bookmarks the same article every two years.
